topic: Repeated-weight GMM Graph service does not bound full execution capacity
mechanism: Host-amortized isolated GMM Graph timing depends on rank route, weight-bank address reuse and capture semantics. Native MemoryAccess rows verify replay work but do not directly reveal physical HBM or cache latency.
environment: Frozen 8xAscend910B3 DP1xTP8 hardware, installed CANN9.1/driver26.0.rc1 container, Run121 cycle64 ordinal64 same all-rank route, packed format29 W4A8 GMM1/GMM2 product shapes. Isolated synthetic zero-input/weight Graph; original FULL Graph not measured in this bank comparison.
observed: Run348 direct events included Host enqueue. Run349-351 different-ordinal composite route gave rank0 eight/single/eight GMM1 132.966/135.929/134.821us, GMM2 67.029/65.369/65.121us, inside A/A2 drift. Same-ordinal all8 Run354-356 bank1/bank8/bank1 gave GMM2 B +8.037% median vs controls and strict slower on8/8 ranks; GMM1 +0.212% and4/8. Run358-360 last two full native 16-task replays per bank condition show unchanged AIC main-memory94728KB and GM-to-L1 93824KB, while profiled duration rose83.592 to91.092us. Run365 separate nonzero eight-bank fixture exact-matched all16 Graph outputs to eager on120 active rows.
failure_or_limit: Run361 raw int64 scale gate was invalid; Run364 full padded row equality was invalid, corrected by Run365 active-prefix gate. Run358/359 profiler flow-event correlation failed, so profiled time is not attained service. Counters do not prove physical HBM bytes, L2 behavior or root cause. Timed fixture uses zero weights/inputs, Host overlap does not prove per-replay device overlap, no Target/DSpark/HCCL contention, compulsory work or Product critical path. Bank1/bank8 do not bracket actual FULL Graph latency.
revalidate_when: Correlate same-cycle original FULL Graph Target and DSpark route, GMM2 MemoryAccess/cache state and downstream join under all8 contention; then place service costs in resource-constrained DAG and only promote through frozen correctness and repeated formal E2E.
extreme_relation: Hardware/Resource conditional service sensitivity and Scheduling node-cost dependence. Current Formal571.681tok/s unchanged; finite Hardware/Scheduling/Product upper endpoint unknown.
